map.输入当前本站气压与近 3 小时气压变化量，判断气压系统类型、变化趋势与未来天气走: Enter the current station pressure and the pressure change over the last 3 hours to determine the pressure system type, its trend and the future weather direction.
map.📖 查看「气压系统移动路径 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Pressure System Movement Path User Guide"
map.按本站气压分型：不低于 1025 hPa 为强高压、1020 至 1024 高压: Classification by station pressure: not below 1025 hPa strong high, 1020 to 1024 high, 1010 to 1019 normal, 1000 to 1009 low, below 1000 strong low; trend by 3-hour tendency: tendency not below +1.5 hPa rapid rise (high approaching, weather improving but windy), +0.5 to 1.4 slow rise, −0.5 to +0.4 steady, −1.5 to −0.6 slow fall, below −1.5 rapid fall (low or front approaching, often turning rainy and windy).
map.3小时气压变化 ΔP (hPa，升正降负): 3-hour pressure change ΔP (hPa, positive for rising, negative for falling)
map.💡 高压（P>1020）多晴好天气，低压（P<1000）多阴雨；3小时变压 ΔP: 💡 High pressure (P>1020) brings mostly fine weather and low pressure (P<1000) mostly rain; a 3-hour pressure change ΔP>1.5 means the system is approaching fast, and <-1.5 means the low is deepening and the weather is worsening.
map.本站气压需订正到海平面（本工具假定输入为海平面气压）: Station pressure must be reduced to sea level (this tool assumes the input is sea-level pressure)
map.3小时变压是判断气压系统移动和强度变化的重要指标: The 3-hour pressure tendency is an important indicator of pressure system movement and intensity change
map.天气走向为经验性判断，实际需结合风场、湿度等综合分析: The weather direction is an empirical judgment and in practice must be combined with wind field, humidity and other factors
map.由气压场梯度与地转风估高压/低压移动方向速度。: Estimate the direction and speed of high/low movement from the pressure gradient and geostrophic wind.
map.短期预报系统何时影响本地。: Short-term forecast of when the system will affect the local area.
map.对比槽脊位置判天气转折。: Compare trough/ridge positions to judge weather transitions.
map.地面低压中心西边 500km 有强梯度，地转风引导其以约 30 km/h 东移: A strong gradient 500 km west of the surface low center; the geostrophic wind steers it eastward at about 30 km/h → it affects the local area in about 16 hours, bringing precipitation.
map.西风槽东移过境后转脊控制 → 由阴雨转晴好，路径与移速决定转折时刻。: After the westerly trough moves east and passes, ridge control follows → from rainy to fine, and the path and movement speed determine the time of transition.
map.近似沿引导气流（高层风）移动，速度与其强度/梯度相关，实际受地形下垫面扰动。: They move approximately along the steering flow (upper-level wind), with speed related to their intensity/gradient, and in practice are disturbed by terrain and the underlying surface.
map.能预报几天？: How many days can it forecast?
map.路径只能短临（1–2 天）粗略，精确移向移速靠数值模式。: The path can only be roughly nowcast (1-2 days); accurate direction and speed rely on numerical models.
map.输入当前本站气压与近 3 小时气压变化量，依据气压高低判定气压系统类型，结合变压: Enter the current station pressure and the pressure change over the last 3 hours; the pressure level determines the pressure system type, the tendency judges the system's movement direction and intensity change, and an empirical outlook of the future weather direction is given.
